openGates: close-range Hitch still richer on painted rivet field and English-word stencil
notes: PQ-050.01 leaf closeout. chase_form_v17. Five chase cycles. Hitch-plus PASS at chase for the C4 notes. Parent unproven / not G7. Bake/map MTX rows are not_applicable: this leaf used Principled islands after the texture-density crash lesson. Old cycle/iter reports deleted; final set is chase_form_v17.

rows.notes: Angle bevel ~10 mm then weighted normals on manufactured meshes; hard shade on hull/wings.
Eight authored chine stations: needle, canard, canopy crown, wing-root, waist, radiator house, drive house, transom.
FAST/EXACT booleans cut canopy tub, windshield, dorsal radiator, wing wells, drive well and bore.
Chase-visible wells: greenhouse, radiator cassette, drive throat. No seats or cabin kit.
Dorsal plate course with seam gaps; wing tiles; inset dorsal seams.
Lofted blunt-TE diamond wings with root strake, fences, flaps as separate bodies.
Thin dark glass mass in a cut raked tub with brow/rails/sill. No solid brick.
Open dorsal-aft well, lofted bell, hub, ceramic heat ring, vanes receding in the bore.
Dorsal fin cassette in a rimless well; inboard wing radiator wells.
Twin guns with bores, dorsal sensor, four RCS blocks with cups.
Lofted service hoses with end fittings (rad→drive, canopy→rad, port cheek).
Clamps and cargo latch only at interfaces, not a rivet field.
Bevels applied after transform; hardware uses 0–6 mm widths.
Unmirrored port repair, port HN plaque, starboard 07, offset hatch and cargo crate.
Weighted normals reapplied after booleans; hard shade on manufactured names.
Unique UV0 via smart project on exported meshes. No shared atlas.
No unique bake maps this leaf. Principled islands avoid the 512/4k density trap.
No UV1 tiling detail layer; meso is modeled panels.
